trigger.rationale: Composite threshold unchanged -- sweep showed negligible effect across 0.55-0.75. Disagreement threshold raised 0.35->0.45 AND fundamentals excluded from the spread calc -- flat trigger-rate curve across the tested grid pointed to a structural cause (stale monthly fundamentals mechanically disagreeing with daily news/vessel), not pure mis-thresholding.

human_review.rationale: Old flat 0.30 flagged 0/20 real episodes -- the real disagreement_index distribution topped out at 0.205 (95th percentile), so 0.30 was set above the ceiling of what the metric could produce. Adopted the calibration notebook's own 80th-percentile suggestion instead.

credibility_floor.rationale: UNCHANGED -- not covered by the Step 5 calibration notebook. Still an assumption, not a validated value.
